mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_document(title, source, institution, publish_date, created_at) VALUES(#{title}, #{source}, #{institution}, #{publishDate}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT rd.id AS reportId, rd.title AS title, rd.source AS source, rd.institution AS institution, rd.publish_date AS publishDate, rd.created_at AS createdAt, ij.job_uid AS jobUid, ij.ocr_status AS ocrStatus, ij.chunk_status AS chunkStatus, ij.vector_status AS vectorStatus, ij.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, ij.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM report_document rd LEFT JOIN ingest_job ij ON ij.id = ( SELECT MAX(i2.id) FROM ingest_job i2 WHERE i2.report_id = rd.id ) WHERE (#{titleKeyword} = '' OR LOWER(rd.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{titleKeyword}), '%')) ORDER BY rd.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
